description: Benzoate chromophore: neutral aspirin λmax at 276 nm (ε 8900), hydrolysis to salicylate shifts absorption to 303 nm — a key degradation indicator in pharmaceutical QC.
transition: π→π* at 226 nm (primary π-π*) + E₂ band at 276 nm; salicylate anion shifts to 303 nm
clinicalNote: Hydrolyzes to salicylic acid (λmax shifts to 303 nm) — key degradation indicator. Assayed by UV at 276 nm (acid) or 303 nm (alkaline).

sources.citation: British Pharmacopoeia 2023, Aspirin Monograph. Assay at 276 nm; salicylate form at 303 nm in 0.1M NaOH.
